# Anbennar Overhaul: generated by tools/build_advancements.py from tools/data/advancements.py; do not edit by hand.

# Character scope (the mage).

# Advancements are for ruling mages
aov_adv_eligible = {
	is_landed = yes
	aov_is_mage = yes
}

aov_adv_is_committed = {
	has_variable = aov_adv_committed
}

# KEY = an advancement key
aov_adv_working_on = {
	has_variable = aov_adv_committed
	var:aov_adv_committed = flag:$KEY$
}

aov_adv_magical_fortress_can_start = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = AOV_ADV_REQ_ELIGIBLE
		aov_adv_eligible = yes
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = AOV_ADV_REQ_NOT_COMMITTED
		NOT = { aov_adv_is_committed = yes }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = AOV_ADV_REQ_NOT_DONE
		aov_adv_magical_fortress_level < 3
	}
	trigger_if = {
		limit = { aov_adv_magical_fortress_level = 0 }
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = AOV_SPELL_REQ_ABJURATION_1
			aov_school_level_at_least = { SCHOOL = abjuration LEVEL = 1 }
		}
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { aov_adv_magical_fortress_level = 1 }
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = AOV_SPELL_REQ_ABJURATION_2
			aov_school_level_at_least = { SCHOOL = abjuration LEVEL = 2 }
		}
	}
	trigger_else = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = AOV_SPELL_REQ_ABJURATION_3
			aov_school_level_at_least = { SCHOOL = abjuration LEVEL = 3 }
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = aov_adv_magical_fortress_req_gold
		gold >= aov_adv_magical_fortress_next_gold
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = aov_adv_magical_fortress_req_mana
		aov_mana >= aov_adv_magical_fortress_next_mana
	}
}
